title: Why Write It Down?
summaryZh: 退休老師瑪格麗特三十年來每天早上七點上山抄氣象數字。一個十五歲的男孩帶著手機來問她:這些手機都知道了,妳為什麼還要寫?

sentences.text: Every morning at seven, Margaret Rowe walks up the hill behind her house.
sentences.zh: 每天早上七點,瑪格麗特・羅走上她家後面那座小山。

sentences.text: At the top there is a small white wooden box standing on four legs.
sentences.zh: 山頂上有一個白色小木箱,立在四隻腳上。

sentences.text: Inside the box are two thermometers, and beside it stands a rain gauge.
sentences.zh: 箱子裡有兩支溫度計,旁邊立著一個雨量筒。

sentences.text: She writes down three numbers: the highest temperature, the lowest, and the rain.
sentences.zh: 她記下三個數字:最高溫、最低溫,還有雨量。

sentences.text: She has done this since the spring of 1996.
sentences.zh: 從一九九六年春天開始,她就一直這樣做。

sentences.text: Margaret taught science at the school in the valley for twenty-eight years.
sentences.zh: 瑪格麗特在谷地那所學校教了二十八年自然科學。

sentences.text: She is seventy-one now, and the walk takes her longer than it used to.
sentences.zh: 她現在七十一歲,這段路走起來比以前久。

sentences.text: The notebooks are kept in a cupboard, one for each year, thirty of them.
sentences.zh: 筆記本收在一個櫃子裡,一年一本,總共三十本。

sentences.text: In thirty years, nobody has ever once asked to see them.
sentences.zh: 三十年來,從來沒有人開口要看過它們。

sentences.text: The cupboard is in the hall, and its door does not close properly any more.
sentences.zh: 櫃子放在走廊上,櫃門已經關不太緊了。

sentences.text: In August a boy named Emil came up the hill with her.
sentences.zh: 八月時,一個叫艾米爾的男孩跟著她上了山。

sentences.text: He was fifteen and he needed a science project for the new school year.
sentences.zh: 他十五歲,新學年需要一份自然科學報告。

sentences.text: His mother had suggested Margaret, and he had come without much interest.
sentences.zh: 他媽媽建議他來找瑪格麗特,他來的時候興趣不大。

sentences.text: He watched her open the box, read the thermometers, and write in pencil.
sentences.zh: 他看著她打開箱子、讀溫度計,然後用鉛筆記下來。

sentences.text: The whole thing took four minutes, and he had his question ready before she finished.
sentences.zh: 整件事花了四分鐘,她還沒寫完,他的問題就準備好了。

sentences.text: He held up his phone and showed her the weather for their village.
sentences.zh: 他舉起手機,給她看他們村子的天氣。

sentences.text: Temperature, rainfall, wind, all of it, updated every ten minutes and free.
sentences.zh: 溫度、雨量、風速,全都有,每十分鐘更新一次,而且免費。

sentences.text: "So why write it down at all?" he asked. It was not a rude question.
sentences.zh: 「那到底為什麼還要用手寫?」他問。這不是一個沒禮貌的問題。

sentences.text: Margaret said something about habit, and about liking the walk up in the morning.
sentences.zh: 瑪格麗特說了些關於習慣的話,還說她喜歡早上走這段上坡。

sentences.text: She knew while she was saying it that it was not a real answer.
sentences.zh: 她一邊說一邊知道,這不是一個真正的答案。

sentences.text: Then Emil looked properly at the open page of her notebook, and he stopped.
sentences.zh: 接著艾米爾認真看了她攤開的那一頁,然後停了下來。

sentences.text: Her rainfall for the previous day was fourteen millimetres.
sentences.zh: 她記的前一天雨量是十四毫米。

sentences.text: His phone, for the same day and the same village, said two.
sentences.zh: 他的手機上,同一天、同一個村子,顯示的是兩毫米。

sentences.text: He checked it twice, and then he went back and checked the day before as well.
sentences.zh: 他檢查了兩次,然後又往回查了前一天。

sentences.text: Nine millimetres in the notebook, and nothing at all on the phone.
sentences.zh: 筆記本上是九毫米,手機上完全沒有。

sentences.text: "Your phone is not measuring anything here," Margaret said.
sentences.zh: 「你的手機在這裡沒有量任何東西,」瑪格麗特說。

sentences.text: "The nearest real station is twelve kilometres away, on the far side of the ridge."
sentences.zh: 「最近的實測站在十二公里外,在山脊的另一邊。」

sentences.text: "Everything it tells you about this valley is a calculation, not a reading."
sentences.zh: 「它告訴你的關於這座山谷的一切,都是算出來的,不是量出來的。」

sentences.text: Emil put his phone into his pocket and did not take it out again.
sentences.zh: 艾米爾把手機放進口袋,之後就沒有再拿出來。

sentences.text: Emil looked at the ridge, and then at the white box, and then at the notebook.
sentences.zh: 艾米爾看了看山脊,再看看白箱子,然後看看筆記本。

sentences.text: "So this is the only record of the rain that actually falls here," he said.
sentences.zh: 「所以這是這裡實際落下的雨,唯一的紀錄,」他說。

sentences.text: Margaret said yes, because it was simply true and there was nothing to add.
sentences.zh: 瑪格麗特說是,因為這就是事實,沒有什麼好補充的。

sentences.text: Emil asked how many mornings she had missed in thirty years.
sentences.zh: 艾米爾問她,三十年來有幾個早上沒去。

sentences.text: "Four," she said, and she named all four without having to think.
sentences.zh: 「四個,」她說,而且不用想就把四個都說了出來。

sentences.text: A funeral, two days in hospital, and the morning that her husband died.
sentences.zh: 一場葬禮、住院兩天,還有她丈夫過世的那個早上。

sentences.text: Emil did not say anything for a while, and then he asked her about Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 艾米爾好一陣子沒說話,然後他問了她星期六的事。

sentences.text: He wanted to know whether he could come up on his own and read the numbers.
sentences.zh: 他想知道自己能不能一個人上來,親手讀那些數字。

questions.q: What does Margaret record every morning?
options: The highest and lowest temperature and the rainfall
The wind speed and the direction of the clouds
The time of sunrise and the state of the sky

questions.q: Why do the phone and the notebook disagree about the rain?
options: The phone calculates from a station beyond the ridge
The rain gauge on the hill has stopped working properly
Margaret writes down the weekly total, not the daily one

questions.q: What makes Emil change his mind about the notebooks?
options: He works out that nothing else measures this valley
He learns that Margaret used to teach at his school
He finds that his project needs thirty years of data
